name: counter
description: Keyboard-first Electron POS for a Ghanaian beverage shop. Anti-shrinkage forensics on every cedi.

scripts.dist:win: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg:arm64 --publish never && electron-builder --mac dmg:x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:all: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder -mwl --publish never
scripts.dist:win:vat: cross-env COUNTER_VAT=1 npm run icons && cross-env COUNTER_VAT=1 npm run build && cross-env COUNTER_VAT=1 electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.vat.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:vat: cross-env COUNTER_VAT=1 npm run icons && cross-env COUNTER_VAT=1 npm run build && cross-env COUNTER_VAT=1 electron-builder --mac dmg:arm64 --config electron-builder.vat.cjs --publish never && cross-env COUNTER_VAT=1 electron-builder --mac dmg:x64 --config electron-builder.vat.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:vat: cross-env COUNTER_VAT=1 npm run icons && cross-env COUNTER_VAT=1 npm run build && cross-env COUNTER_VAT=1 electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.vat.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win:friendly: npm run icons && cross-env COUNTER_FRIENDLY=1 npm run build && cross-env COUNTER_FRIENDLY=1 electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.friendly.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:friendly: npm run icons && cross-env COUNTER_FRIENDLY=1 npm run build && cross-env COUNTER_FRIENDLY=1 electron-builder --mac dmg:arm64 --config electron-builder.friendly.cjs --publish never && cross-env COUNTER_FRIENDLY=1 electron-builder --mac dmg:x64 --config electron-builder.friendly.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:friendly: npm run icons && cross-env COUNTER_FRIENDLY=1 npm run build && cross-env COUNTER_FRIENDLY=1 electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.friendly.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win:counters: npm run icons && cross-env COUNTERS_DECOY=1 npm run build && cross-env COUNTERS_DECOY=1 electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.counters.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:counters: npm run icons && cross-env COUNTERS_DECOY=1 npm run build && cross-env COUNTERS_DECOY=1 electron-builder --mac dmg:arm64 --config electron-builder.counters.cjs --publish never && cross-env COUNTERS_DECOY=1 electron-builder --mac dmg:x64 --config electron-builder.counters.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:counters: npm run icons && cross-env COUNTERS_DECOY=1 npm run build && cross-env COUNTERS_DECOY=1 electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.counters.cjs --publish never

linux.description: Counter is an offline-first point-of-sale for small beverage shops. Tracks every cedi from sale to bank, with anti-shrinkage audit trails.
